players.inj_detail: Fell ill before Dallas' Oct 13 game and has missed two games, including Oct 14 at Colorado. He is listed day-to-day and Dallas hopes to have him back for its next game.

recap.impact: No threat to you. They lead you by 47 points today, but you're projected to finish about 99 points ahead of them.

recap.text: The title race is a three-way dead heat. Dom Scavuzzo jumped from 4th to 1st projected, with odds up from 11% to 18%. 97 Problems slipped to 2nd at 17%, and Lord of the Rinks sits 3rd at 17%. Debits & Checks are next at 9%.
recap.impact: You're right in it: about 6 projected points separate you from 1st, and the gap to 4th is about 15 points.

recap.text: Biggest movers: PhilCap fell from 3rd to 5th projected (9% to 8%) with Ivan Demidov and William Eklund both on injured reserve. Anthony Scavuzzo dropped from 11th to 14th after Travis Konecny and Mats Zuccarello went on injured reserve. In the real standings, Debits & Checks climbed from 9th to 2nd and RDR slid from 3rd to 10th.
recap.impact: Good for you. PhilCap was one of the teams projected just behind you a week ago, and now sits about 16 points back.

recap.text: Top pool scorers this week: Auston Matthews 9 points (Girl on the Lake), William Nylander 8 (Debits & Checks), and Alexis Lafreniere, Tim Stutzle and Sebastian Aho with 7 each. Dom Scavuzzo got 6 apiece from Brandon Hagel and Nikita Kucherov.
recap.impact: Hagel and Kucherov are the ones that hurt: they powered the team that just passed you. Kaprizov's 5 points led your roster.

recap.text: Role changes on your roster: Anton Frondell dropped from Chicago's top power-play unit to the second, Porter Martone moved up to Philadelphia's second line but back to the second power-play unit, and Brady Tkachuk moved onto Florida's top line. Sam Reinhart is centring Florida's second line with Aleksander Barkov out 6 to 8 weeks.
recap.impact: Small knocks for Frondell and Reinhart, who were already projected for modest totals. Martone's bigger even-strength role is a mild plus.

recap.text: Injuries: Jake Sanderson is still day-to-day with a lower-body injury and has played one game. Travis Konecny and Mats Zuccarello joined the injured reserve list, and Connor Bedard, Ryan Nugent-Hopkins and Mathew Barzal remain out.
recap.impact: Sanderson is the one to watch for you: he has one game played, and every game he misses is one fewer from your defence.

lens.headline: Kaprizov's hat trick kept you in a three-way race, now 3rd projected.
bullets: You're 16th in the real standings with 29 points, but projected to finish 3rd with about 737, and your roster still projects 1st in the pool from here on.
Win odds slipped from 18.7% to 17.1% since last week's recap, and top-3 odds from 40% to 39%, as Dom Scavuzzo jumped past you from 4th to 1st projected.
The projected gap to 1st is about 6 points (737 to 743). Closing it comes down to your cold shooters: Wyatt Johnston, Sam Reinhart and Brady Tkachuk have 35 shots between them and no goals.

Kaprizov drove the week with 5 points, including a hat trick against Florida, and Dylan Holloway had a three-assist night. Kaprizov's 6 goals on 13 shots are running hot, while Frondell lost his top power-play spot and Reinhart is centring a line without Barkov.
Next week, watch Sanderson's return from his lower-body injury, whether Johnston and Reinhart finally score, and Dom Scavuzzo's Hagel and Kucherov, who had 6 points each this week.

items.headline: Boldy bags three and a helper
items.body: Three goals and an assist in Minnesota's 5-4 win over St. Louis. Dom Scavuzzo climb from 12th to 9th.

items.headline: Brady Tkachuk does it again
items.body: His second big night this week: a hat trick in Florida's 3-2 win over Vancouver. Lord of the Rinks rise to 13th.

items.headline: Stone hammers three past Calgary
items.body: A hat trick for Mark Stone in Vegas' 6-2 win over the Flames. This Is the Year hold 7th in the real standings.

items.headline: Marchenko's hat trick not enough
items.body: Three goals for Kirill Marchenko, but Toronto fell 5-4 to Buffalo. Eric's Elite still slip from 11th to 12th.

items.headline: Quinn Hughes makes it seven straight
items.body: Seven straight games with a point for Quinn Hughes, with 11 points in that run for Matthew's Team.
